versions.changelog:
Initial release of geo-content

- Provides a structured framework to assess content quality and E-E-A-T (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness) for AI citability.
- Details specific, point-based criteria and signals for all four E-E-A-T dimensions.
- Includes content quality metrics such as word count benchmarks, readability, and paragraph structure recommendations.
- Guides users through evaluating both on-page and site-wide signals that impact citation likelihood by AI platforms.
- Designed to generate comprehensive content analysis reports (GEO-CONTENT-ANALYSIS.md) following assessment.
